verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents several ways to get an isolated test environment. `cockroach demo` spins up a temporary in-memory cluster, optionally with a preloaded dataset, and a single-node cluster is described as suitable for quick SQL testing. Separate free-trial cloud clusters can be created via `ccloud quickstart`, and Continuum virtual clusters are pitched for developers and agents. Missing for 10: a documented branch or clone of production data into a sandbox, explicit guidance on scoping the MCP server or agents to non-production clusters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
